command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
outside=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v "^$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)

findings.message: design.md D6 contradicts Accepted ADR-0006: the ADR says exemplar cities are 'extracted at build time into a small JSON file' and 'CLDR extraction adds a build step', but D6 says 'The build does not run the script' (a hand-run script writing committed JSON). The design's Context also claims it follows ADR-0006's 'CLDR exemplar cities extracted at build time'. Either follow the ADR or refer the change to docs/adr/ instead of settling it in design.md.

design.md D12 departs from Accepted ADR-0005, which says 'the view-contract BDD E2E scenarios are parameterized by the registry and run for every registered view'. D12 only makes the steps view-agnostic 'so they can run for every registered view once a view-mode setting exists', and no task in section 9 parameterizes the add/remove view-contract scenarios by viewRegistry.

design.md D12 says 'Screenshots use Playwright toHaveScreenshot with SCREENSHOT_MAX_DIFF_PIXEL_RATIO', but neither the constant nor toHaveScreenshot exists anywhere under packages/client/, and no task creates the constant (task 1.4 lists the new constants without it).
design.md D1 says 'task 3.4 adds its row to the command table of docs/architecture/domain-model.md', but in tasks.md that is task 2.6; task 3.4 exports the adapters and runs Stryker.

Task 8.1 requires the shadcn Dialog to use 'token classes only' (UX5; antipatterns.md: 'Inline styles instead of tokens — no magic numbers in code'), but tailwind.config.ts and styles/tokens.css define only background, foreground, muted-foreground, accent, notice and the day-period colours. There is no token for the dialog backdrop, a dialog surface or border, or the error state, and no task adds them.

Task 2.5 runs the 'Remove a location' and 'Location identity' spec scenarios in locations_management.feature against the real reducer and store, with nothing rendered, yet 'Remove the last location' asserts 'the empty state is shown' and 'Raw offset is rejected' asserts 'nothing is stored'. Neither can be checked at model level; the tasks need to move or reword those steps.

Task 8.3 TDDs views/shared/LocationSearchDialog 'with an in-memory CitySearch', which implies the view takes a port, while .claude/rules/architecture.md says 'views never call the reducer or ports directly' and D9 says 'Views receive presenter output only'. The tasks should state that the dialog receives presenter output and callbacks (or uses the useCitySearch controller hook with an injected loader), not a CitySearch port.

findings.message: Spec/design contradiction on lazy search data (NFR-P2): specs/location-search/spec.md scenario 'Data loads only when the search opens' asserts 'the search data has not been requested' before the search opens, and NFR-P2 says the chunk is loaded 'only when the search is opened'. But design.md Context/D8 relies on Workbox precache: 'The Workbox globPatterns in vite.config.ts precache every js and json asset, so a lazy chunk is available offline after the first visit (FR16)'. vite.config.ts has globPatterns ['**/*.{js,mjs,css,html,ico,png,svg,json,woff2}'], so the service worker downloads the city-search- chunk on first visit before the search opens. The scenario is false as written and task 9.3's 'no city-search- request before the search opens' check depends on whether Playwright observes SW requests. Reword NFR-P2, the scenario and task 9.3 to a true, testable property (not in initial JS, not imported by the page until the search opens).

FR13 is not fully met, and the design makes a false claim about existing code: the spec requires 'When storage cannot be written ... the existing storage warning MUST be shown', but D5 discards SaveOutcome.FAILED and relies on 'the existing useStorageAvailability probe, which already fails in the same conditions'. useStorageAvailability probes once on mount (useEffect(() => setIsStorageAvailable(storageAvailability.isStorageAvailable()), [storageAvailability])) with a one-character PROBE_VALUE = "1". A later save that fails (quota reached, or a document too large while the probe fits) returns FAILED and no warning is shown. The controller should raise the warning on FAILED, covered by a test in task 6.1/8.8.

D4 binds localStorageLocationRepository 'to globalThis.localStorage', but the existing adapter documents that 'the access itself may throw' (localStorageAvailability.ts wraps the access in try/catch). Task 3.3 only covers a throwing setItem, not a throwing localStorage getter at load or bind time, so the provider could crash the app, against FR12 ('The app never shows a blank page because of stored data') and FR13. Add the case to D4 and to task 3.3's tests.

Task 8.6 only says to wrap views/cards/CardsView.test.tsx in LocationsProvider, but that file contains it('should offer no action while there is nothing to act on') expecting queryByRole('button') to be absent, which contradicts FR17's 'Add location' action. The task must replace that assertion.

Minor inconsistency: D3 says useLocations() returns '{ locations, loadStatus, addLocation, removeLocation, resetLocations }', while D9 and task 6.1 say it also returns rows from presentLocationRows. The design should give one definition.
